artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan shipping both a shared fixture-tested census tool (census-count.sh with occurrences/membership/cross-check subcommands) and two standards docs (shell-script-testing.md, census-methodology.md), plus the validate-no-task-references.sh separator-regex fix with its own regression suite. Settles six decisions up front (D1-D6) including harness location, helper naming, fixture strategy, and the task-qualified-only Phase remit.

memory_candidates.content: Registration asymmetry in agent-system extension manifest.json: provides.scripts is a list of individual relative FILE paths that may be subdirectory-qualified (core itself already registers lint/lint-contract-compliance.sh and lint/lint-postflight-boundary.sh), so any new script -- including one in a scripts/tests/ subdirectory -- must be added there explicitly. By contrast provides.context lists DIRECTORY names ('standards', 'formats', 'patterns', ...), not files, so a new context/standards/*.md file needs NO manifest.json change -- only an index-entries.json entry (path relative to context/, plus domain/subdomain/summary/line_count/keywords/topics/load_when). Check which shape an array uses before assuming a new artifact needs a manifest edit.
